extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 表达式 Σuₙ = u₁ + u₂ + u₃ + ...

extracted_concepts.name: 常数项级数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 项为常数的无穷级数

extracted_concepts.name: 数列
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 给定数列 {uₙ}

extracted_concepts.name: 部分和
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sₙ = u₁ + u₂ + ... + uₙ

extracted_concepts.name: 级数收敛
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 部分和数列 {Sₙ} 有极限 S

extracted_concepts.name: 级数的和
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 收敛时部分和数列的极限 S

extracted_concepts.name: 级数发散
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 部分和数列 {Sₙ} 没有极限

extracted_concepts.name: 收敛的必要条件
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 若 Σuₙ 收敛，则 lim uₙ = 0

extracted_concepts.name: 线性性质
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 若 Σaₙ 和 Σbₙ 都收敛，则 Σ(αaₙ + βbₙ) 收敛

extracted_concepts.name: 有限项不影响收敛性
aliases: finite terms do not affect convergence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 增删有限项不改变级数收敛性

extracted_concepts.name: 加括号性质
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 收敛级数任意加括号仍收敛

extracted_concepts.name: 正项级数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 各项非负的级数

extracted_concepts.name: 比较判别法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 若 0 ≤ uₙ ≤ vₙ 且 Σvₙ 收敛，则 Σuₙ 收敛

extracted_concepts.name: 比值判别法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 若 lim uₙ₊₁/u = ρ，则 ρ < 1 收敛，ρ > 1 发散

extracted_concepts.name: 根值判别法
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 若 lim ⁿ√uₙ = ρ，则 ρ < 1 收敛，ρ > 1 发散

extracted_concepts.name: 幂级数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 形如 Σaₙ(x-a)ⁿ 的级数

extracted_concepts.name: 收敛半径
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: R = 1/lim |aₙ₊₁/aₙ|

extracted_concepts.name: 阿贝尔定理
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 幂级数收敛或发散点的区间性质

extracted_concepts.name: 绝对收敛
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 在 |x| < |x₀| 时绝对收敛

extracted_concepts.name: 收敛区间
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 幂级数收敛的 x 的范围

extracted_concepts.name: 逐项求导
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 在收敛区间内幂级数可逐项求导

extracted_concepts.name: 逐项积分
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 在收敛区间内幂级数可逐项积分

extracted_concepts.name: 泰勒级数
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 将函数在某点展开为幂级数

extracted_concepts.name: 函数展开
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 将函数在某点展开为幂级数

extracted_concepts.name: 幂级数运算
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: 在收敛区间内逐项求导、逐项积分
